skill.summary: Research local questions, group them into clusters, and draft launch-ready FAQ copy for a executive recruiting firm. Use when handling local SEO work...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – provides a structured process for generating local SEO FAQ clusters for executive recruiting firms.

- Researches local questions relevant to executive recruiting.
- Groups questions into clusters for effective SEO coverage.
- Drafts launch-ready FAQ copy tailored for executive recruiting firms.
- Includes workflow steps for clarifying requirements and refining output.
- Lists relevant SEO keywords and guidelines for use and human review.
